# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security updates target the latest release. Check [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/AdiRishi/turborepo-remote-cache-cloudflare/releases) for the current server version, and follow [Update your deployment](https://turborepo-remote-cache.dev/update) to upgrade your copy.

## Report a vulnerability

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting. On the repository's **Security** tab, select **Report a vulnerability**. See [GitHub's reporting guide](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) for details.

Include the affected version, reproduction steps, and the impact. Remove tokens and credentials from logs and examples. Keep the report private while the maintainers investigate and prepare a fix.

The maintainers will acknowledge the report and keep you informed as they investigate. Public advisories credit the reporter unless the reporter requests anonymity.

For questions about this policy that do not disclose a vulnerability, open a GitHub issue.
